Name: Farm Computer Plus
Author: boebie
Description:
This mod adds another dialogue box onto the existing Farm Computer dialogue box. When you interact with the Farm Computer it will show you the normal Farm stats, then you go to the next dialogue box and it'll show you the stats for Ginger Island.

The mod will also display a "!" alert over the computer when crops or machines are ready to be harvested (Island Crops Ready, Island Machines Ready, Greenhouse crops ready). The number of crops needed to display the alert can be changed using Generic Mod Config Menu.

Adds the following information to the Farm Computer:

Ginger Island:
[list]
[*]Total Crops
[*]Crops Ready
[*]Unwatered Crops
[*]Open Tilled Soil
[*]Machines Ready﻿
[/list]
More Information:
[list]
[*]Cellar Casks Ready (Supports multiple cabins)
[*]Supports Grandpa's Shed from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
[/list]
